sortieLines.line: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The Callback stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ SORTIE — Kaushik, Nina, Jorge take up arms and a day's rations (6,124 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Callback mauled Kaushik (-83 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.
